name: GBP AutoReply AI
author: Guru Plugins

sections.description:
GBP AutoReply AI helps you manage your Google Business Profile (GBP) reviews from your WordPress dashboard and generate professional, friendly replies with AI (GPT). Great for small businesses, agencies, and anyone who wants to save time while managing customer feedback!

Features:
* Add unlimited Google Business Profiles (GBPs) – no Google authentication needed!
* Add, edit, and delete reviews for each GBP (manual entry)
* Generate AI-powered replies using OpenAI GPT (customizable prompt)
* One-click copy to clipboard for generated replies
* Link directly to the GBP review on Google to paste your reply
* Customize the AI prompt with your own tone, style, or variables
* Revert the prompt to default anytime
* Sleek, modern admin dashboard with accordion UI and modals

How it works:
1. Add your Google Business Profiles (just a name and Google Maps URL).
2. Manually add reviews as they come in.
3. Click “Generate Reply” to use AI to create a reply, then copy/paste it directly on your GBP.
4. All data is stored locally — no Google credentials or authentication needed.

Pro version available for Agencies
Manage hundreds of GBPs, automate review importing, and connect directly to Google’s official API (for approved users)!
See: https://plugins.guru-is.com/product/gbp-autoreply-ai

External services

This plugin can connect to the OpenAI API to generate suggested replies to customer reviews.

Service used:
– OpenAI API (api.openai.com)

What is it used for?
To generate AI-assisted draft replies for your Google Business Profile reviews inside the WordPress admin.

What data is sent and when?
– When you click a button to generate or regenerate an AI reply, the plugin sends the prompt content to OpenAI. This typically includes:
– The review text and star rating you are viewing
– Optional business/reviewer context you entered in the plugin’s settings or prompt template
– Any instructions you provide to customize the reply
– Network metadata (such as your server’s IP address and user-agent) may be transmitted as part of the HTTPS request handled by WordPress.

Where is data sent?
– Requests are sent to OpenAI’s API at https://api.openai.com.

Under which conditions?
– Only when an OpenAI API key is entered in the plugin settings and you explicitly trigger a request (e.g., “Generate AI Reply”).
– If no OpenAI API key is set, no data is sent to OpenAI and AI features remain disabled.

What is stored?
– Your OpenAI API key is stored in your WordPress options table.
– Your configured prompt template and any AI-generated replies you choose to save are stored in your WordPress database.
– The plugin does not store data on external servers other than sending it to OpenAI to obtain AI responses.

OpenAI policies:
– Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
– Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
– API Data Usage: https://openai.com/policies/api-data-usage

Notes for site owners:
– Do not include sensitive or personal information in prompts unless you have a legal basis and consent to do so.
– If you wish to avoid any data being sent externally, simply leave the OpenAI API key field empty; the AI features will be disabled.

Privacy

This plugin can send review text and your prompt content to OpenAI for the sole purpose of generating a suggested reply, but only when you enable the feature by providing an API key and explicitly requesting a reply. Generated replies and your prompt settings are stored in your WordPress database. No tracking scripts are added to the frontend.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ or install via Plugins > Add New in the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to the “GBP AutoReply AI” admin menu to get started.
sections.faq:
Does this connect to my Google account?

No. The free version does not require or use Google authentication.
You add GBP profiles and reviews manually.

Does it automatically fetch my reviews?

No, due to Google API restrictions. You add reviews manually and reply using AI.

Can I use this for multiple GBPs?

Yes! Add as many profiles as you like.

How do I get AI replies?

Enter your OpenAI API key (free or paid) in the plugin settings. The plugin uses GPT-3.5/4 to generate replies.

Does this plugin send data to third-party services?

Yes, but only if you provide an OpenAI API key and click to generate an AI reply. In that case, the review text and prompt content are sent to the OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com) to create a suggested reply. If you do not provide an API key, nothing is sent externally and AI features remain disabled.

Is my data secure?

All data is stored in your WordPress database. No information is sent anywhere except to OpenAI for replies (when you click Generate Reply).

Where can I get the Pro version?

Visit https://plugins.guru-is.com/product/gbp-autoreply-ai for details.
